set.body: Phase 1 review finding 6 of 8. R/execution.R preflight drops declared compute fields such as block_features and memory_bytes, while R/receipt.R accepts contradictory worker counts between compute and memory plans, arbitrary precision labels, weak revision strings, and class-tagged nested objects without revalidation. Preserve the complete immutable compute policy, validate source capabilities and strong revision metadata, constrain enums, and enforce cross-object consistency for workers, memory, source access, completion, task counts, timing, BLAS identity, and numerical policy. Done when forged nested objects and contradictory receipts fail and a valid receipt round-trips every declared policy field.
set.title: Enforce policy consistency in preflight and execution receipts
